semiconductor_relevance: High — CMTX Co., Ltd. specializes in manufacturing consumable parts and materials specifically for semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: CMTX Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of consumable parts and materials for the semiconductor industry, focusing on high-performance components such as dry etcher parts, quartz, ceramics, and sapphire. The company is vertically integrated, ensuring high-quality production from raw materials to finished products.
capabilities: Manufacturing of consumable dry etcher parts
Production of high-functional sapphire and ceramic parts
Advanced machining, lapping, and polishing technologies
Development of unique technologies such as bonding and micro machining
technical_expertise: Material science for ceramics and sapphire

regional_presence.Korea: CMTX has top-level machining and polishing technology based in Korea, focusing on R&D to innovate in semiconductor parts manufacturing.
